title: Cymbopogon citratus cream for medicinal use
intro: Cymbopogon citratus cream is a topical herbal preparation made from the essential oil of lemongrass, which is derived from the dried leaves of the Cymbopogon citratus plant. This cream is commonly used in herbalism for its calming and anti-inflammatory properties. It is often applied to the skin to relieve muscle pain, reduce inflammation, and promote relaxation. The active compounds in lemongrass, such as citral and geraniol, contribute to its therapeutic effects. It is particularly favored in aromatherapy and natural medicine for its soothing and uplifting qualities.
